title: A lane height under 8 pixels silently renders at the default 28
foundBy: session agent of a consuming timeline page, measuring a headless Chromium render; relayed by the repository owner
details:
A finite `height` under 8 is replaced with 28, and nothing says so at the point of use. The TSDoc on `height` says only that the default is 28, and no development warning fires. The component document names the floor under its edge cases, and that document does not ship.

A consuming page asked for a 6-pixel gap lane, got a 28-pixel one, and the bands it had measured from its rows landed 22 pixels off. A height the component will not draw should be reported in development, as an invalid span is, and the floor should be named where the prop is declared.
